title: Bonsai Automata
game_overview: An idle zen simulation featuring automated power and irrigation grids to grow bonsais to level 100, combined with reaction-based wilderness excursions.
winning_condition: Successfully discover and cultivate the rarest botanical specimen in the wilderness—the Mythic Golden Ginkgo Bonsai—to Level 100 Mastery in your automated sanctuary.
losing_condition: None. The game is a relaxing zen experience with no fail state or game over. When the expedition backpack reaches maximum capacity, the player simply cannot carry additional items and returns to the starting campsite portal to transport all gathered resources back to the sanctuary.

controls.action: Dig action in the radial shovel minigame during excursions.

controls.input: W/A/S/D or Arrow Keys / Virtual Joystick
controls.action: Move the botanist explorer across the excursion overworld.
Select bonsais to prune, purchase machinery upgrades, and manage inventory slots.
Open inventory and equipment backpack screen.
Switch between Greenhouse Sanctuary and Wilderness Excursion view.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Parent Specimen Preservation on Propagation: Propagating an adult Level 100 bonsai no longer removes or destroys the parent specimen from its sanctuary grid plot. Instead, the parent bonsai is retained directly in its plot and reset to Level 0 (boosted by +10 levels per rank of the 'Propagation Expert' skill, up to Level 50), while preserving 100% of accumulated Care Points (CP), Genetic Potential (GP), Maturity Rating, Style, and Blooming Phenotype. 2. New Growing Skills in Zen Library: Added two new skills in the 'Growing' category positioned immediately after 'Hydrodynamics Irrigation T3': (a) 'Propagation Expert' (5 upgrades: Rank 1 & 2 requiring Branch Rank 1 for 1 & 2 Zen Points; Rank 3 & 4 requiring Branch Rank 2 for 3 & 4 Zen Points; Rank 5 requiring Branch Rank 3 for 5 Zen Points; granting +10 reset levels per upgrade); (b) 'Offshoot Multiplier' (3 upgrades: Rank 1 requiring Branch Rank 1 for 2 Zen Points; Rank 2 requiring Branch Rank 2 for 5 Zen Points; Rank 3 requiring Branch Rank 3 for 8 Zen Points; granting +1 extra offshoot cutting per upgrade in the Offshoot Planting minigame, scaling from 2 up to 5 total attempts). 3. Catalog Refinement: Completely removed 'Automaton Green Thumb' and 'Automaton Hydrodynamics' from the Zen Library skill registry.
sections.summary: Parent Specimen Preservation on Propagation, Propagation Expert & Offshoot Multiplier Skills, and Skill Catalog Refinement.
